_metadata.purpose: Filtration ranking of the residential wall series, used when the customer mentions allergy, dust or air quality. bot.py sends it in the server context and quote warns when a better tier of the same size exists. Rules point here instead of restating the order.
_metadata.basis: The filters each series lists in the price lists (knowledge/toshiba, knowledge/samsung). The price lists describe filters but give no measured performance, so the order is the owner's sales judgement.
_metadata.decided: 2026-10-15, owner. HAORI has a plasma ionizer + Ultra Pure like DAISEIKAI 10 (the Slovak catalog's 'ozone purifier' was a mistranslation).
_metadata.tiers_note: Tier 1 is the best. Series within a tier are equal: respect the brand the customer named, otherwise offer the cheaper one. Tier 4 is never recommended for allergy.
_metadata.coverage: bot.py refuses to start when a wall series in the price lists is missing here or a series here no longer exists. The console unit (Parapetna_jednotka) is a different unit type and stays out.
